train_ogb_molhiv: train a GraphNetwork on the OGB molhiv dataset using pmap for multi-device training with optax adam optimizer
evaluate_molhiv_model: evaluate a saved GraphNetwork model on the OGB molhiv dataset and return loss and accuracy metrics
build_graph_network: build a jraph GraphNetwork with edge, node, and global update functions for molecular property prediction
compute_graph_loss: compute cross-entropy loss and accuracy for graph classification with padding mask handling
batch_graphs_for_devices: batch graphs from a DataReader iterator to match the number of JAX local devices for pmap
